Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 0 degrees now, clear sky. Next 24 hours: high 8, low -3.

German authorities refused entry to a 25-year-old Albanian citizen at Memmingen airport after finding inconsistencies in his declarations.

Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot said he will ask President Isaac Herzog next week to approve the formation of a new government, a move that could oust Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

A fire broke out at the back door of the Pulse nightclub in Koçan, causing panic and a stampede toward the main entrance.

Kosovo's delay and funding disputes threaten the planned 2030 Mediterranean Games, putting the country's broader reputation at risk.

Bayern Munich awarded German midfielder Jamal Musiala a €22 million bonus as part of his contract renewal slated for February 2025.
